info.title: NabaPresence internal HTTP API
info.description: Route and authentication inventory for app/api. Core session and review responses include shared Zod schemas. Other payloads are defined in the linked handlers and lib/contracts. An empty security array means no session or cron authentication in the wrapper; a webhook may verify its provider in the handler.
